verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents two first-party natural-language paths. Composer lets you 'tell Composer what you're trying to achieve' and it builds the audience, drafts content, maps the send strategy and can make supported changes. The official MCP server lets AI agents like Claude or Cursor act on Klaviyo data from prompts such as 'Create an email campaign promoting our Memorial Day sale', covering tasks from campaign creation to flow reports. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work reliably, and documentation of which operations Composer's 'supported changes' cover versus what still requires the UI.
